Package com.egradx.notification.web.admin

Class EgradxNotificationPlatformAdminController

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.notification.web.admin.EgradxNotificationAdminEndpoints
com.egradx.notification.web.admin.EgradxNotificationPlatformAdminController
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.beans.factory.Aware, org.springframework.context.ApplicationEventPublisherAware
@RestController @RequestMapping("/egradx/notifications/admin/platform") public class EgradxNotificationPlatformAdminController extends EgradxNotificationAdminEndpoints
The same endpoints as EgradxNotificationAdminController, for what belongs to no single organization: templates and channel settings that apply to every organization without their own, the log of platform-level messages, in-app notices to every user, and sends to every user.

Everything here needs egradx.notification.broadcast, which egradx-auth lets only a role in the platform organization hold. This is where the in-process APIs' two widest reaches — publishToPlatform and toAllUsers() — are exposed, and the one place they are.
